title: Privacy policy
content:
1. Overview

This Privacy Policy explains how Creatives® Studio (“we,” “our,” or “us”) collects and uses information when you visit our website or contact us through any of our services.

2. Information We Collect

We may collect:

  • Contact details you share through forms or email.
  • Analytics data about how visitors use this website (pages visited, device type, region).
  • Project inquiries or submissions sent through our contact form.

3. How We Use Information

We use collected information to:

  • Respond to inquiries and client requests.
  • Improve our website and services.
  • Communicate updates or relevant information about our work.

4. Cookies & Analytics

Our website may use cookies or similar tools to analyze traffic and improve user experience.
You can disable cookies in your browser at any time.

5. Sharing of Data

We do not sell or trade personal data.
We may use third-party tools (like analytics or email services) that process data on our behalf in compliance with privacy laws.

6. Data Retention

We retain data only as long as necessary for the purposes listed above. You may request deletion of your personal data by contacting us.

7. Security

We take reasonable steps to protect information from loss or unauthorized access. However, no digital platform is completely secure.

8. Changes

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version is always available on this page.

9. Contact

For privacy-related questions, email privacy@creative.studio
